verses.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.pt: Então todo o Israel se ajuntou a Davi em Hebron, dizendo: Eis que somos teus ossos e tua carne.
verses.en_web: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.en_bbe: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.

verses.en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.pt: Já dantes, quando Saul ainda era rei, eras tu o que fazias Israel sair, e entrar; também o Senhor teu Deus te disse: Tu apascentaras o meu povo Israel; tu seras príncipe sobre o meu povo Israel.
verses.en_web: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
verses.en_bbe: In the past, when Saul was king, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in; and the Lord your God said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel, and their ruler.

verses.en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
verses.pt: Assim vieram todos os anciãos de Israel ao rei, a Hebrom; e Davi fez com eles um pacto em Hebrom, perante o Senhor; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do Senhor por intermédio de Samuel.
verses.en_web: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.
verses.en_bbe: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel, as the Lord had said by Samuel.

verses.en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.pt: Então Davi, com todo o Israel, partiu para Jerusalém , que é Jebus; e estavam ali os jebuseus, habitantes da terra.
verses.en_web: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.en_bbe: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (which is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the people of the land, were there.

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.pt: E disseram os habitantes de Jebus a Davi: Tu não entrarás aqui. Não obstante isso, Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião, que é a cidade de Davi.
verses.en_web: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
verses.en_bbe: And the people of Jebus said to David, You will not come in here. But still, David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.

verses.en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.pt: Davi disse: Qualquer que primeiro ferir os jebuseus será chefe e capitão. E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, subiu primeiro, pelo que foi feito chefe.
verses.en_web: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
verses.en_bbe: And David said, The first to overcome the Jebusites will be chief and captain. And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, went up first, and became chief.

verses.en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.pt: Então Davi habitou na fortaleza, e por isso foi chamada cidade de Davi.
verses.en_web: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
verses.en_bbe: And David took the strong tower for his living-place, so it was named the town of David.

verses.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.pt: E edificou a cidade ao redor, desde Milo em diante; e Joabe reparou o resto da cidade.
verses.en_web: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.en_bbe: And he took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo; and Joab put the rest of the town in order.

verses.en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.pt: Davi tornava-se cada vez mais forte; porque o Senhor dos exércitos era com ele.
verses.en_web: David grew greater and greater; for Yahweh of Armies was with him.
verses.en_bbe: And David became greater and greater in power, because the Lord of armies was with him.

verses.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.pt: São estes os chefes dos valentes de Davi, que o apoiaram fortemente no seu reino, com todo o Israel, para o fazerem rei, conforme a palavra do Senhor, no tocante a Israel.
verses.en_web: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the chief of David's men of war who were his strong supporters in the kingdom, and, with all Israel, made him king, as the Lord had said about Israel.

verses.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.pt: Esta é a relação dos valentes de Davi: Jasobeão, filho dum hacmonita, o chefe dos trinta, o qual, brandindo a sua lança contra trezentos, duma só vez os matou.
verses.en_web: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
verses.en_bbe: This is the list of David's men of war: Ishbaal, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the three: he put to death three hundred at one time with his spear.

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.pt: Depois dele, Eleazar, filho de Dodó, o aoíta; ele estava entre os três valentes.
verses.en_web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.en_bbe: And after him was Eleazar, the son of Dodo the Ahohite, who was one of the three great fighters.

verses.en: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.pt: Este esteve com Davi em Pas-Damim, quando os filisteus ali se ajuntaram à peleja, onde havia um pedaço de campo cheio de cevada; e o povo fugia de diante dos filisteus.
verses.en_web: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.en_bbe: He was with David at Pas-dammim, where the Philistines had come together for the fight, near a bit of land full of barley; and the people went in flight before the Philistines.

verses.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.pt: Mas eles se puseram no meio daquele campo, e o defenderam, e mataram os filisteus; e o Senhor os salvou com uma grande vitória.
verses.en_web: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.
verses.en_bbe: And he took up his position in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack, and overcame the Philistines; and the Lord gave a great salvation.

verses.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.pt: Três dos trinta chefes desceram à penha; a ter com Davi, na caverna de Adulão; e o exército dos filisteus estara acampado no vale de Refaim.
verses.en_web: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.en_bbe: And three of the thirty went down to David, to the rock, into the strong place of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Bethlehem.
verses.pt: Davi estava então no lugar forte, e a guarnição dos filisteus estava em Belém.
verses.en_web: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
verses.en_bbe: At that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.

verses.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
verses.pt: E Davi, ofegante, exclamou: Quem me dera beber da água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta!
verses.en_web: David longed, and said, “Oh that one would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
verses.en_bbe: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of the water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem by the doorway into the town!

verses.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.pt: Então aqueles três romperam pelo arraial dos filisteus, tiraram água do poço de Belém, que estava junto à porta, e a trouxeram a Davi; porém Davi não a quis beber, mas a derramou perante o Senhor,
verses.en_web: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: So the three, forcing a way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David; but David would not take it, but made an offering of it, draining it out to the Lord,

verses.en: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.pt: dizendo: Não permita meu Deus que eu faça isso! Beberia eu o sangue da vida destes homens? Pois com perigo das suas vidas a trouxeram. Assim, não a quis beber. Isso fizeram aqueles três valentes.
verses.en_web: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, By my God, far be it from me to do this! How may I take as drink the life-blood of these men who have put their lives in danger? so he did not take it. These things did the three great men of war.

verses.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.pt: Abisai, irmão de Joabe, era o chefe dos três; o qual, brandindo a sua lança contra trezentos, os matou, e teve nome entre os três.
verses.en_web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
verses.en_bbe: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty, for he put to death three hundred with his spear, but he had not a name among the three.

verses.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.pt: Ele foi mais ilustre do que os outros dois, pelo que foi feito chefe deles; todavia não igualou aos primeiros três.
verses.en_web: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
verses.en_bbe: Of the thirty, he was the noblest, and was made their captain, but he was not equal to the first three.

verses.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.pt: Havia também Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, filho de um homem valente de Cabzeel, autor de grandes feitos; este matou dois filhos de Ariel de Moabe; depois desceu e matou um leão dentro duma cova, no tempo da neve.
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.en_bbe: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, a fighting-man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death two young lions going into their secret place; and he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow.

verses.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.pt: Matou também um egípcio, homem de grande altura, de cinco côvados. O egípcio tinha na mão uma lança como o órgão de tecelão; mas Benaías desceu contra ele com um cajado, arrancou-lhe da mão a lança e com ela o matou.
verses.en_web: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.en_bbe: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a very tall man about five cubits high, armed with a spear like a cloth-worker's rod; he went down to him with a stick, and pulling his spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.pt: Estas coisas fez Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, pelo que teve nome entre os três valentes.
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.en_bbe: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.

verses.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.pt: e o mais ilustre, contudo não igualou aos primeiros três; e Davi o pôs sobre os da sua guarda.
verses.en_web: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
verses.en_bbe: He was honoured over the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three: and David put him over his servants.

verses.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.pt: Os valentes dos exércitos: Asael, irmão de Joabe; El-Hanã, filho de Dodó, de Belém;
verses.en_web: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.en_bbe: And these were the great men of war: Asahel, the brother of Joab, Elhanan, the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

verses.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.pt: Samote, o harorita; Helez, o pelonita;
verses.en_web: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.en_bbe: Shammoth the Harodite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,
verses.pt: Ira, filho de Iques, o tecoíta; Abiezer, o anatotita;
verses.en_web: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.en_bbe: Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

verses.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.pt: Sibecai, o husatita; Ilai, o aoíta;
verses.en_web: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.en_bbe: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.pt: Maarai, o netofatita; Helede, filho de Baaná, o netofatita;
verses.en_web: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.en_bbe: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled, the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.pt: Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá, dos filhos de Benjamim; Benaías, o piratonita;
verses.en_web: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.en_bbe: Ithai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.pt: Hurai, dos ribeiros de Gaás; Abiel, o arbatita;
verses.en_web: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.en_bbe: Hurai of Nahale-gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.pt: Azmavete, o baarumita; Eliabá, o saalbonita;
verses.en_web: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.en_bbe: Azmaveth of Bahurim, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.pt: dos filhos de Hasem, o gizonita: Jônatas, filho de Sage, o hararita;
verses.en_web: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan, the son of Shage the Hararite,

verses.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.pt: Aião, filho de Sacar, o hararita; Elifal, filho de Ur.
verses.en_web: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.en_bbe: Ahiam, the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal, the son of Ur,

verses.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.pt: Hefer, o mequeratita; Aías, o pelonita;
verses.en_web: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.en_bbe: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.pt: Hezro, o carmelita; , Naarai, filho de Ebzai;
verses.en_web: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.en_bbe: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai, the son of Ezbai,

verses.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.pt: Joel, irmão de Natã; Mibar, filho de Harri;
verses.en_web: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.en_bbe: Joel, the brother of Nathan, Mibhar, the son of Hagri,

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.pt: Zeleque, o amonita; Naarai, o berotita, escudeiro de Joabe, filho de Zeniia;
verses.en_web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.en_bbe: Zelek the Ammonite, and Naharai the Berothite, the servant who had the care of the arms of Joab, the son of Zeruiah;

verses.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.pt: Ira, o itrita; Garebe, o itrita;
verses.en_web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.en_bbe: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.pt: Urias, o heteu; Zabade, filho de Alai;
verses.en_web: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.en_bbe: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad, the son of Ahlai,

verses.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.pt: Adina, filho de Siza, o rubenita, chefe dos rubenitas, e com ele trinta;
verses.en_web: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.en_bbe: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;

verses.en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.pt: Hanã, filho de Maacá; Jeosafá, o mitnita;
verses.en_web: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.en_bbe: Hanan, the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.pt: Uzias, o asteratita; Sama e Jeiel, filhos de Hotão, o aroerita;
verses.en_web: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.en_bbe: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

verses.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.pt: Jediael, filho de Sínri, e Joá, seu irmão, o tizita;
verses.en_web: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.en_bbe: Jediael, the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

verses.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.pt: Eliel, o maavita; Jeribai e Josavias, filhos de Elnaão; Itma, o moabita;
verses.en_web: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.en_bbe: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.pt: Eliel, Obede e Jaasiel, o mezobaíta
verses.en_web: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.en_bbe: Eliel and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
